title: Learning Varying Physical Therapist-Patient Interactions for Robot-mediated Upper Limb Task-Specific Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.15995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Upper extremity motor function recovery is positively linked to Task-Specific Training (TST) and sufficient therapy dosage. Rehabilitation robots can increase TST dosage via controlled, repetitive treatment and free therapists to simultaneously manage other patients, but it has yet to demonstrate significant benefits over conventional treatment. This is potentially linked to inaccurate robotic representation of personalised physical therapist-patient interaction and lack of practice variability during TST. Hence, we advocate for robotic interventions that preserve the personalised physical therapist-patient interactions when delivering TST for patients across varying practise conditions. translated_title: 学习变化的物理治疗师-患者互动用于机器人介导的上肢任务特异性训练
translated_abstract: 上肢运动功能恢复与任务特异性训练（TST）和足够的治疗剂量正相关。康复机器人可以通过受控、重复的治疗增加TST剂量，并解放治疗师以同时管理其他患者，但尚未显示出优于传统治疗的显著优势。这可能与机器人对个性化物理治疗师-患者互动的不准确表示以及TST期间缺乏实践变异性有关。因此，我们主张在跨不同实践条件下为患者提供TST时，保留个性化物理治疗师-患者互动的机器人干预。我们提出了一种基于任务参数化高斯混合模型（TPGMM）的从演示学习框架，用于学习任务特异性练习中的个性化物理治疗师-患者互动，将患者关节运动学映射到治疗师施加的力。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于TPGMM的从演示学习框架，以保留个性化物理治疗师-患者互动并增加实践变异性，从而提升机器人介导上肢任务特异性训练的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Learning-from-Demonstration framework using TPGMM to preserve personalized therapist-patient interactions and enhance practice variability for improving robot-mediated upper limb task-specific training.
